title: Sučić and Lautaro sink Stuttgart as Bastoni goes off
description: Inter beat VfB Stuttgart 2–0 and rise to 12th in the Champions League with nine points.
mast_alt: Nerazzurri Daily Edition No. 86, Thursday, November 26, 2026 — Sučić and Lautaro sink Stuttgart as Bastoni goes off

blocks.html: Inter beat VfB Stuttgart 2–0 at San Siro on Wednesday. Petar Sučić, the midfielder, scored a penalty, and Lautaro Martínez, the captain, added a second off the bench. Alessandro Bastoni, the center back, went off before halftime, and Sky Sport Italia reports a sore left thigh.

paras: The win takes Inter to nine points from five matches and 12th place in the Champions League table.
“That’s the target, but we’re taking it one game at a time,” Sučić said. Inter play Borussia Dortmund away on December 9.

blocks.h3: Chivu: “We did well in every aspect”
paras: Cristian Chivu, Inter’s head coach, praised the team’s attitude. “The team has to remain together and not lose its unity,” he said.
Nicolò Barella, the midfielder, was named UEFA Player of the Match. “We showed character,” he said.
Inter’s under-23 team, coached by Stefano Vecchi, lost 3–0 away to Audace Cerignola in Serie C, Italy’s third division. They are ninth with 23 points from 15 matches.

Bastoni asked to come off in the 41st minute, and Federico Dimarco, the wing back, replaced him. Sky Sport Italia reports soreness in the quadriceps of his left thigh. He is due to have scans, and his place against Genoa on Saturday is at risk.
blocks.kicker: SKY SPORT ITALIA VIA CALCIOMERCATO (ITALIAN SOCCER SITE) · NOV 25

paras: Lautaro came on in the 69th minute and scored five minutes later.
